definition: To make someone sad because something was not as good as they hoped.
examples: I'm sorry to disappoint you.
The movie disappointed me.
Don't disappoint your parents.

spanish.definition: Poner triste a alguien porque algo no fue tan bueno como esperaba.

definition: The path of something moving around a planet or star; to move around it.
examples: The moon orbits the Earth.
The satellite is in orbit.
It takes a year for Earth to orbit the sun.

spanish.definition: Camino de algo que gira alrededor de un planeta o estrella; girar así.

definition: The feeling of being sorry for someone who has a problem.
examples: I have a lot of sympathy for her.
He sent a card to show his sympathy.
Don't expect any sympathy from me.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento de pena por alguien que tiene un problema.

definition: A doctor who treats mental illness.
examples: She sees a psychiatrist once a week.
The psychiatrist gave him some medicine.
My brother is a psychiatrist in Boston.

spanish.definition: Médico que trata enfermedades mentales.

definition: To meet someone or something, often by chance; a meeting of this kind.
examples: We encountered some problems on the way.
I had a strange encounter on the train.
He encountered an old friend in the street.

spanish.definition: Conocer o toparse con alguien o algo, a menudo por casualidad.

definition: To go somewhere with someone.
examples: I'll accompany you to the door.
A parent must accompany the child.
She accompanied her mother to the hospital.

spanish.definition: Ir a algún lugar con alguien.

definition: A tall stone post that holds up a building; a part of a page or a table.
examples: The old bank has big white columns.
Write your name in the first column.
She writes a column for the newspaper.

spanish.definition: Poste alto de piedra que sostiene un edificio; parte de una página o tabla.

definition: To breathe out loudly because you are tired, sad or relaxed.
examples: She sighed and closed the book.
He gave a long sigh.
We all sighed when we saw the bill.

spanish.definition: Soltar el aire con fuerza por cansancio, tristeza o alivio.

definition: Connected to money, trade and business in a country.
examples: The country has serious economic problems.
Economic growth was slow last year.
We need a new economic plan.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con el dinero y el comercio de un país.

definition: A child who behaves badly.
examples: That kid is a spoiled brat.
Stop acting like a brat.
The little brat kicked me!

spanish.definition: Niño que se porta mal.

definition: Extremely funny.
examples: That video is hilarious!
She told a hilarious story at dinner.
The show was absolutely hilarious.

spanish.definition: Extremadamente gracioso.

definition: Expensive and only for a few people; not shared with others.
examples: They stayed at an exclusive hotel.
This is an exclusive offer for our members.
It's a very exclusive club.

spanish.definition: Caro y solo para pocas personas; no compartido con otros.

definition: To say hello to someone.
examples: She greeted me with a big smile.
He greets everyone at the door.
Our dog greets us when we come home.

spanish.definition: Decirle hola a alguien.

definition: A period of ten years.
examples: We've lived here for a decade.
Prices have gone up in the last decade.
It's the best movie of the decade.

spanish.definition: Período de diez años.

definition: A state of not understanding or not being sure.
examples: There was some confusion about the time.
I'm sorry for the confusion.
She looked at me in confusion.

spanish.definition: Estado de no entender o no estar seguro.

definition: The low sound of something heavy falling.
examples: The book fell with a thud.
We heard a loud thud upstairs.
The bag hit the floor with a thud.

spanish.definition: Sonido bajo de algo pesado que cae.

definition: Very bad or unpleasant.
examples: The weather was dreadful.
What a dreadful thing to say!
I had a dreadful headache.

spanish.definition: Muy malo o desagradable.

definition: A yellow metal; musical instruments made of this metal.
examples: The door has a brass handle.
The lamp is made of brass.
He plays in a brass band.

spanish.definition: Metal amarillo; instrumentos musicales de este metal.

definition: To become smaller.
examples: My sweater shrank in the wash.
These jeans won't shrink.
The company has shrunk in the last few years.

spanish.definition: Hacerse más pequeño.

definition: A message sent by computer; to send this message.
examples: I'll send you an email.
Please email me the photos.
I got twenty emails this morning.

spanish.definition: Mensaje enviado por computadora; enviarlo.

definition: Having a good flavor.
examples: This soup is really tasty.
We had a tasty lunch.
She makes tasty cookies.

spanish.definition: Que tiene buen sabor.

definition: The science of what things are made of and how they change.
examples: I have a chemistry test tomorrow.
She teaches chemistry at the high school.
There's real chemistry between the two actors.

spanish.definition: Ciencia de qué están hechas las cosas y cómo cambian.

definition: A small paper on a product with information; to put one on something.
examples: Read the label before you take the medicine.
She labeled all the boxes.
The label says it's made in Mexico.

spanish.definition: Papel pequeño en un producto con información; ponerlo.

definition: A person or animal that spends time with you.
examples: My dog is my best companion.
She was his companion for fifty years.
They were travel companions.

spanish.definition: Persona o animal que pasa tiempo contigo.

definition: A game in which you buy a ticket and can win money by luck.
examples: He won the lottery last year.
I bought a lottery ticket.
What would you do if you won the lottery?

spanish.definition: Juego en el que compras un boleto y puedes ganar dinero por suerte.

definition: A small long animal with no legs that lives in the ground.
examples: The bird caught a worm.
There's a worm in this apple!
We use worms for fishing.

spanish.definition: Animal pequeño y largo sin patas que vive en la tierra.

definition: Attention from newspapers, television and the internet.
examples: The movie got a lot of publicity.
He doesn't like publicity.
They need more publicity for the event.

spanish.definition: Atención de los periódicos, la televisión e internet.

definition: An insect with large colorful wings.
examples: A butterfly landed on my hand.
The garden is full of butterflies.
I have butterflies in my stomach before a test.

spanish.definition: Insecto con alas grandes de colores.

definition: The words people say in a book, a movie or a play; a talk between people.
examples: The dialogue in this movie is great.
Practice this dialogue with a partner.
The two sides started a dialogue.

spanish.definition: Palabras que dicen las personas en un libro, película u obra; conversación.

definition: Very large or very good.
examples: We had a tremendous time.
There was a tremendous noise.
He made a tremendous effort.

spanish.definition: Muy grande o muy bueno.

definition: To start a company or organization; to make something exist.
examples: The school was established in 1950.
We need to establish some rules.
They established a new company in Texas.

spanish.definition: Fundar una empresa u organización; hacer que algo exista.

definition: Very close and personal; small and comfortable.
examples: They are intimate friends.
We had an intimate dinner at home.
It's an intimate little restaurant.

spanish.definition: Muy cercano y personal; pequeño y cómodo.

definition: Wanting very much to do something.
examples: The kids are eager to open their presents.
She's eager to learn.
He's eager to start his new job.

spanish.definition: Que quiere mucho hacer algo.

definition: To have something inside.
examples: This box contains old photos.
Does this cake contain nuts?
Oranges contain a lot of vitamin C.

spanish.definition: Tener algo adentro.

definition: A talk that gives information to a group of people.
examples: I have to give a presentation at work.
Her presentation was very clear.
The presentation starts at nine.

spanish.definition: Charla que da información a un grupo de personas.

definition: Becoming sick when you touch, eat or breathe something.
examples: I'm allergic to peanuts.
She's allergic to cats.
He had an allergic reaction to the medicine.

spanish.definition: Que se enferma al tocar, comer o respirar algo.

definition: To give back money that you borrowed.
examples: I'll repay you next week.
He repaid the loan in two years.
How can I ever repay you?

spanish.definition: Regresar dinero que pediste prestado.

definition: A person who works in government or wants to be elected.
examples: Many people don't trust politicians.
The politician gave a long speech.
She's a local politician.

spanish.definition: Persona que trabaja en el gobierno o quiere ser elegida.

definition: A way of thinking based on good reasons.
examples: I don't understand the logic of this plan.
There's no logic in what he says.
Use logic to solve the problem.

spanish.definition: Manera de pensar basada en buenas razones.

definition: The feeling of being thankful.
examples: I want to show my gratitude.
She looked at him with gratitude.
He wrote a letter of gratitude to the nurses.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento de estar agradecido.

definition: Something that is not included in a rule.
examples: There's an exception to every rule.
We can make an exception this time.
Everyone came, with the exception of John.

spanish.definition: Algo que no está incluido en una regla.

definition: An agreement in which each person gets part of what they want; to reach one.
examples: We finally reached a compromise.
You have to compromise in a marriage.
They compromised on the price.

spanish.definition: Acuerdo en que cada persona obtiene parte de lo que quiere; llegar a él.

definition: More than half of a group.
examples: The majority of students passed.
A majority of people voted yes.
Women are the majority in this class.

spanish.definition: Más de la mitad de un grupo.

definition: A serious magazine; a book where you write about your day.
examples: She keeps a journal of her trip.
He wrote an article in a medical journal.
I write in my journal every night.

spanish.definition: Revista seria; libro donde escribes sobre tu día.

definition: A place where ships stop; a wooden platform at the edge of water.
examples: The ship is at the dock.
We sat on the dock with our feet in the lake.
The boat left the dock at noon.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde paran los barcos; plataforma de madera al borde del agua.

definition: Completely necessary.
examples: Water is essential for life.
A good diet is essential.
It's essential to arrive on time.

spanish.definition: Completamente necesario.

definition: The usual weather in a place.
examples: Florida has a warm climate.
Climate change is a serious problem.
I prefer a dry climate.

spanish.definition: El tiempo habitual de un lugar.

definition: The work of managing an organization; the government of a president.
examples: She works in hospital administration.
The new administration changed the law.
He studied business administration.

spanish.definition: Trabajo de dirigir una organización; gobierno de un presidente.

definition: Having very strong feelings about something.
examples: He's passionate about music.
She gave a passionate speech.
They had a passionate relationship.

spanish.definition: Que tiene sentimientos muy fuertes sobre algo.

definition: Exact and correct.
examples: Can you be more precise?
I need the precise time.
She gave precise instructions.

spanish.definition: Exacto y correcto.

definition: An area of short grass around a house.
examples: He mows the lawn every Saturday.
The kids are playing on the lawn.
We have a small lawn in front of the house.

spanish.definition: Área de pasto corto alrededor de una casa.

definition: Pants made of strong blue cotton.
examples: I wear jeans every day.
She bought a new pair of jeans.
These jeans are too tight.

spanish.definition: Pantalones de algodón azul y fuerte.

definition: A place where people go for a vacation.
examples: We stayed at a beach resort.
It's a famous ski resort.
The resort has three pools.

spanish.definition: Lugar a donde va la gente de vacaciones.

definition: Long thin pieces of fried potato.
examples: I'd like a burger and fries.
These fries are too salty.
Do you want fries with that?

spanish.definition: Trozos largos y delgados de papa frita.

definition: The amount that something can hold; the ability to do something.
examples: The stadium has a capacity of fifty thousand.
This tank has a capacity of fifty liters.
She has the capacity to learn fast.

spanish.definition: Cantidad que algo puede contener; habilidad para hacer algo.

definition: A person who plays or fights against you.
examples: His opponent is very strong.
She shook hands with her opponent.
He beat his opponent in the first round.

spanish.definition: Persona que juega o pelea contra ti.

definition: Used when you take one number away from another; below zero.
examples: Ten minus three is seven.
It's minus five degrees outside.
What's twenty minus eight?

spanish.definition: Se usa para restar un número de otro; bajo cero.

definition: An object for making music; a tool for special work.
examples: Do you play an instrument?
The piano is my favorite instrument.
The doctor cleaned her instruments.

spanish.definition: Objeto para hacer música; herramienta para trabajo especial.

definition: A large meeting of people with the same job or interest.
examples: She went to a teachers' convention in Chicago.
They met at a comic book convention.
The convention lasts three days.

spanish.definition: Reunión grande de personas con el mismo trabajo o interés.

definition: A person who takes messages or packages to someone.
examples: A messenger brought the letter.
Don't blame the messenger.
He works as a bike messenger.

spanish.definition: Persona que lleva mensajes o paquetes a alguien.

definition: To travel around a place to learn about it.
examples: We explored the old town on foot.
I want to explore South America.
The kids explored the forest.

spanish.definition: Viajar por un lugar para conocerlo.

definition: Against, especially in a sports game.
examples: Tonight's game is Boston versus New York.
It's the old versus the new.
We talked about renting versus buying a house.

spanish.definition: Contra, especialmente en un juego deportivo.

definition: Clothes that hide who you are; to change how you look so people don't know you.
examples: The thief wore a disguise.
He disguised himself as a doctor.
Nobody knew her in that disguise.

spanish.definition: Ropa que oculta quién eres; cambiar tu aspecto para que no te reconozcan.

definition: A vehicle with two wheels that you move with your feet.
examples: I ride my bicycle to work.
She got a new bicycle for her birthday.
My bicycle has a flat tire.

spanish.definition: Vehículo de dos ruedas que mueves con los pies.

definition: The time when a woman has a baby growing inside her.
examples: She felt sick during her pregnancy.
Pregnancy lasts about nine months.
Don't drink alcohol during pregnancy.

spanish.definition: Tiempo en que una mujer tiene un bebé creciendo adentro.

definition: Made of wood.
examples: We have a wooden table in the kitchen.
They live in a small wooden house.
The kids played with wooden toys.

spanish.definition: Hecho de madera.

definition: The fact of not being guilty; not knowing about the bad things in life.
examples: He tried to prove his innocence.
I love the innocence of small children.
The lawyer believed in her innocence.

spanish.definition: Hecho de no ser culpable; no conocer lo malo de la vida.

definition: A long road where planes take off and land.
examples: The plane is on the runway.
Snow closed the runway.
We waited on the runway for an hour.

spanish.definition: Camino largo donde despegan y aterrizan los aviones.

definition: To help someone.
examples: How may I assist you?
Nurses assist the doctors.
She assisted him with the report.

spanish.definition: Ayudar a alguien.

definition: A person who is not in the army or the police.
examples: Many civilians died in the war.
He went back to civilian life.
Soldiers must protect civilians.

spanish.definition: Persona que no está en el ejército o la policía.

definition: The place at an airport where officers check your bags.
examples: It took an hour to go through customs.
The customs officer opened my bag.
We waited in a long line at customs.

spanish.definition: Lugar en un aeropuerto donde los oficiales revisan tus maletas.

definition: A small sea animal that you can eat.
examples: I ordered fried shrimp.
She's allergic to shrimp.
We had shrimp and rice for dinner.

spanish.definition: Animal pequeño de mar que se puede comer.

definition: A competition to find the best player or team.
examples: Our team won the championship.
She's playing in the world championship.
They lost the championship game.

spanish.definition: Competencia para encontrar al mejor jugador o equipo.

definition: All the people who live in a house; connected to the home.
examples: There are five people in our household.
She does most of the household chores.
Most households have a computer.

spanish.definition: Todas las personas que viven en una casa; relacionado con el hogar.

definition: To stay on the top of water or to move slowly in the air.
examples: Wood floats on water.
A balloon floated over the house.
I like to float in the pool.

spanish.definition: Quedarse sobre el agua o moverse despacio en el aire.

definition: A type of dance that tells a story with music.
examples: My daughter takes ballet classes.
We went to see a ballet.
She has danced ballet since she was five.

spanish.definition: Tipo de baile que cuenta una historia con música.

definition: Not able to hurt anyone or cause problems.
examples: That snake is harmless.
It was just a harmless joke.
Don't worry, the dog is harmless.

spanish.definition: Que no puede lastimar a nadie ni causar problemas.

definition: The wish to know or learn about something.
examples: I opened the box out of curiosity.
Children are full of curiosity.
She looked at him with curiosity.

spanish.definition: Deseo de saber o aprender sobre algo.

definition: Very cruel or violent.
examples: It was a vicious attack.
That's a vicious dog.
He told vicious lies about me.

spanish.definition: Muy cruel o violento.

definition: To take money out of a bank; to move back or leave.
examples: I need to withdraw some cash.
She withdrew from the race.
The army withdrew from the city.

spanish.definition: Sacar dinero de un banco; moverse hacia atrás o salir.

definition: Wanting more money or food than you need.
examples: Don't be greedy; leave some for me.
He's a greedy businessman.
That greedy boy ate all the cake.

spanish.definition: Que quiere más dinero o comida de lo que necesita.

definition: An arrangement to keep a table, a room or a seat for you.
examples: I have a reservation for two at eight o'clock.
We made a hotel reservation.
Do you have a reservation?

spanish.definition: Acuerdo para guardarte una mesa, cuarto o asiento.

definition: A small piece of help to find an answer; to say something in an indirect way.
examples: Can you give me a hint?
She hinted that she wanted a ring.
Here's a hint: it's a kind of fruit.

spanish.definition: Pequeña ayuda para hallar una respuesta; decir algo de forma indirecta.

definition: A small nut that grows in the ground.
examples: I like peanut butter on my toast.
He's allergic to peanuts.
We ate peanuts at the baseball game.

spanish.definition: Fruto seco pequeño que crece bajo tierra.

definition: To risk money in a game; something risky that you decide to do.
examples: He gambled all his money in Las Vegas.
It's a gamble, but I think it will work.
She never gambles.

spanish.definition: Arriesgar dinero en un juego; algo arriesgado que decides hacer.

definition: The season between summer and winter; in American English also called fall.
examples: The leaves change color in autumn.
Autumn is my favorite season.
It's a cool autumn morning.

spanish.definition: Estación entre el verano y el invierno.

definition: Jewelry that you wear around your wrist.
examples: She's wearing a gold bracelet.
He gave me a silver bracelet.
I lost my bracelet at the beach.

spanish.definition: Joya que llevas alrededor de la muñeca.

definition: Thinking that you are better than other people.
examples: He's rich and arrogant.
Don't be so arrogant.
I don't like her arrogant attitude.

spanish.definition: Que piensa que es mejor que los demás.

definition: A movement of the hands or head that shows a meaning; a kind act.
examples: He made a rude gesture.
It was a nice gesture to send flowers.
She used gestures because she didn't speak French.

spanish.definition: Movimiento de las manos o la cabeza con un significado; acto amable.

definition: A paper that shows you paid for something.
examples: Keep your receipt.
You need the receipt to return the shoes.
Can I have a receipt, please?

spanish.definition: Papel que muestra que pagaste algo.

definition: Good wishes, often at the end of a letter.
examples: Please give my regards to your parents.
Best regards, Tom.
He sends his regards.

spanish.definition: Buenos deseos, a menudo al final de una carta.

definition: The country where you were born.
examples: She misses her homeland.
He returned to his homeland after the war.
They had to leave their homeland.

spanish.definition: País donde naciste.

definition: To jump high or far; a big jump.
examples: The cat leaped onto the table.
The dog leaped over the fence.
He took a great leap forward.

spanish.definition: Brincar alto o lejos; un gran brinco.

definition: Very cruel and violent.
examples: It was a savage attack.
The lion is a savage hunter.
The newspaper wrote a savage review.

spanish.definition: Muy cruel y violento.

definition: Close to an exact number.
examples: It takes approximately two hours.
There are approximately fifty people here.
The room is approximately five meters long.

spanish.definition: Cerca de un número exacto.

definition: A small river.
examples: We fished in the creek.
The kids played near the creek.
There's a creek behind our house.

spanish.definition: Río pequeño.

definition: A small type of horse.
examples: She rode a pony at the fair.
My daughter wants a pony.
The pony ate the apple from my hand.

spanish.definition: Tipo de caballo pequeño.

definition: A man who works in business.
examples: He's a successful businessman.
The businessman flew to Tokyo.
My father was a businessman.

spanish.definition: Hombre que trabaja en los negocios.

definition: A country or an area controlled by another country.
examples: America was once a British colony.
The thirteen colonies became the United States.
Brazil was a colony of Portugal.

spanish.definition: País o área controlada por otro país.

definition: How loud a sound is; the amount of space something has.
examples: Can you turn the volume down?
Measure the volume of the water.
The volume on the TV is too high.

spanish.definition: Qué tan fuerte es un sonido; espacio que algo ocupa.

definition: The small part of a plant from which a new plant grows.
examples: We planted seeds in the garden.
This watermelon has no seeds.
Birds love to eat seeds.

spanish.definition: Parte pequeña de una planta de la que crece otra.

definition: A thing that can blow up; able to blow up.
examples: The police found explosives in the car.
Gas is very explosive.
The situation is explosive.

spanish.definition: Algo que puede estallar; capaz de estallar.
